text: Inside, the tunnel ran down toward the sound of the sea. The floor was wet sand.
And in the sand, two sets of footprints. Fins. And boots.
Gus held the lantern low. The fin-prints threw little shadows on the wall, the way prints do.
Mabel’s fur stood up along her whole back.
And then Gus’s lantern went out. Not the lamp. His lantern. In his hand. Without a breath of wind.
